listNote: Rockstar has not published an official trophy list. Names, descriptions and grades below are the list as reported on 18 November 2026 by Push Square, cross-checked against EGamers, GTAScoop, GameMapa and Mobalytics, which all report the same 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze. All trophies are offline single-player; using cheats disables trophies and saving.

sources.note: Full 55-trophy list with counts: 397 stunts, 42 shooting-range challenges, 14 drone races, 18 meditation spots, 18 card sets, 80 challenges, 8 garages.
Same 55 totals; 27 non-hidden, 28 hidden; Positive Mental Attitude the only possibly missable trophy.
Same 55 totals; no online trophies; one playthrough is enough.
Cross-checked list; Gamerscore values from GamesRadar+; five hidden trophies still unsolved.
Same list; one possible missable trophy; free roam after the story for cleanup.

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no extra task behind it, so treat it as a progress meter, not a job of its own. Finish A Long Road last and this follows on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the last one most hunters earn. The 100% checklist appears under Progress after the story ends. You do not need literally everything: 15 of the 18 card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges count toward it, for example. Clear the checklist, then mop up any gameplay challenges left over.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Story only. Finish the campaign and this unlocks with the ending. Once it pops, free roam stays open, so every cleanup trophy can be chased after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Leonida holds 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You need 250, so pick the easy two-thirds and skip the fiddly ones. Stunt jumps are the friendliest: ramps and bridges are everywhere. Check Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts to see what is left, and use Exploration, Stunt Spots on the map to find undiscovered ones.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 challenges across two ranges: Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and every one needs gold. Some challenges stay locked until you meet their condition, which the map shows. Work through one range at a time and use the Activities, Shooting Ranges map filter to find what is open.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands, scattered across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain with its own final mission, and several of those finals carry their own trophies. Take every stranger mission the moment it appears rather than leaving it for later: at least one guide reports that some stranger chains are tied to story progress, so do them as they show up.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: There are 18 card sets in the game and you need any 3 complete. Cards you sell at pawn shops still count toward progress, so sell freely. Track it under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. If you are chasing 100% anyway, this pops on the way, since that needs 15 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK is the phone app (hold Up to open it) that scans points of interest. The scannable set is 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so 100 scans is well within reach once you start scanning everything you pass. Progress lives under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Five bank vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape. Plan the getaway before you go in: a fast car parked close by and a route away from the cops matter more than the robbery itself. Robbing a vault spikes your wanted level fast, so expect this to feed straight into Hot Together as well.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.guide: Story only. Gone Fishing is Jason's first mission, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story only. Finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house with Lucia: it is the one spot in the game tied to the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story only. Finish Chapter 2. The trophy name is printed censored in the published lists; the in-game list shows it in full.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story only. Finish Chapter 3. Nothing to prepare for this one; it pops with the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story only. Finish Chapter 4. By now the stranger missions are opening up across the map; take them as they appear.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story only. Complete the Breakfast Run mission. It pops with the mission, so just play the story through.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story only. Complete The Cartel Heist mission. A story trophy, so no preparation is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story only. Complete the Child's Play mission. It unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story only. Complete the Headliners mission. It pops with the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story only. Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Keep it in mind later for Catch Me if You Can, which also happens at the airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story only. Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. It unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball and three more the game lists under Activities. You do not need to win or finish anything, just try each once. This is a good first-session trophy: sample everything early and the rest of the activity trophies follow naturally.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen drone race locations, one win at each. Some charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find them under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones on the map. Learn each course's corners on a practice run before paying for the race that counts.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Twenty different races won. Repeating the same race does not count, so work through the map: track them under Activities, Racing. Most race spots let you hire a car; if you bring your own, watch its Rating and buy upgrades at a mod shop when the field gets quick.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area until one of the right size bites; you need a boat with a fishing rod, and there are plenty to borrow in the area if you do not own one. Beat Cal's challenge and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and finish one game on it. Any arcade game counts and there is no score target, so pick the shortest one you find and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand ends with the mission Puff Puff Pass. Work through all of Andy's missions in order; the trophy pops when the last one is done. Do stranger strands as they appear so a story window never closes on you.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with the mission Maritime Disputes. Finish every Kenton mission and this pops with the last one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with the mission Hometown Heroes. Complete all of Billy's missions and the trophy follows the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is the vehicle wish list: find and deliver the cars he asks for. His mission list is tracked in the published guides as Randy's Wish List Vehicle Locations. Deliver the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand runs through the Kitty Litter labs. The published guides list every Kitty Litter Lab location, which is the long part of this chain. Finish his missions in order and the trophy pops with the finale.
trophies.name: Spin on This!

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN POSSIBLY MISS. There are 18 meditation spots. The first is Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1: follow her out, accept the prompt, and let the final zen animation play, because a meditation only counts once that animation finishes. That balcony spot is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it while you can. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find spots under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.
trophies.missableReason: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends, and guides cannot confirm whether it counts toward the 18. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants one specific animal hunted. Take the hunting gear, follow the trail markers for Bret's quarry, and take the shot cleanly. This is the hunting strand's payoff trophy; the hunting itself counts toward Master of None too.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's in-built feats: 80 in total, and you need 50. They cover skilled play across combat, driving, flying and exploration. Check Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges to see them all, and pick off the ones that match what you already do well. 100% completion needs 70, so this pops on the road to A Long Road.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to four stars while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. The easiest setup is a bank vault robbery, which hands you four stars on its own. Then break line of sight, get off the road, and wait the heat out with your partner beside you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row, partner at your side, wanted level never dropping between them. Plan a short route between three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving: the trick is staying wanted the whole time, so do not let the heat die between stops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it with WAiNK. One hundred different vehicles sounds like a lot, but a normal story playthrough with a habit of scanning everything you pass gets most of the way there. Track it under Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus. Before the fight, top up your focus with food, a drink or a shower at home, and carry Adrenaline. An assault rifle helps: pick a fight with a group close together, trigger focus, and work through five of them before it runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Vice City International Airport: take a plane and leave without a flight plan, in the game's words an unscheduled departure. Grab an aircraft on the tarmac, get it airborne and clear of the airport. Expect a wanted level on the way out.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: The Rhino tank returns. The description is a joke about the heat inside one, so the job is to get into a Rhino and do something worth the trouble with it. Steal one from a military spot and take it for a spin through the city.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry job: in and out with nobody spotting you. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again another day.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, crack it open, take the cash and get away clean. Ram it or block it, deal with the guards, grab the money and lose the wanted level. A fast getaway car parked nearby turns a hard trophy into a routine one.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every corner of the state. Drive, fly and walk the map until the fog is gone: cities, swamps, beaches, mountains and back roads. The game tracks what you have seen, so keep exploring the blank patches on the map until this pops.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs an illegal operation somewhere. Find one per gang, hit it and get out. You will need to learn which operations belong to which gang, so work through the map gang by gang rather than hitting the same crew twice.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. One of the five hidden trophies the published guides still list as unsolved, so the exact spot is not confirmed yet; the description points at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In the Beginning...

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side, the classic GTA exit. One of the five hidden trophies the guides still list as unsolved, so the exact showroom is not confirmed; any big glass-fronted showroom is the place to try.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper follow-through. Bowling is one of the nine activities, so this pairs naturally with Master of None. Pick a lane, bowl, and let the follow-through animation play out.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train at the gym with each of them until their strength stat is full. Swap between the two as you play so neither lags behind, and this pops when the second one maxes out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Everything shady counts: crimes, getaways, robberies, police attention. It is a pure volume trophy, so it comes naturally over a long playthrough; if it is the last one standing, go on a crime spree and watch the counter climb.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: One of the five hidden trophies the published guides still list as unsolved: the description reads like a retry joke, so it likely involves failing something once and succeeding on the second attempt. No confirmed method yet; the guide will be updated when the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: One of the five hidden trophies the published guides still list as unsolved. The description suggests a strange or surprising event out in the world. No confirmed method yet; check back once players have mapped the odd encounters around Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl someone over. It is a trick shot, so pick a slow target on foot, line the car up beside them, and swing as you pass. Bowling-alley wordplay aside, any melee weapon from any moving vehicle should count.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and they need laundering through your contacts before they spend clean. Keep laundering after every big job and the $250,000 total builds up on its own. This is a money-flow trophy, not a grind: play the crime side of the game and it arrives.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops of any kind: clothes, weapons, food, anything. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, and normal spending on gear and upgrades covers most of it. Find shops on the map under Style if you need to top the total up at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Eight garages, $160,000 all in: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Each adds one parking spot, which also helps On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten different vehicles with Scooter Bros, which then delivers them to you repaired for a small fee. Register any car you drive at a Pay 'N' Spray or mod shop, as long as you have a free parking spot. Buying garages for Little Boxes gives you the spots you need.
trophies.name: On the Spot
